description: ROW contract for family_segregation.tsv (one row per inferred family per candidate). Counts informative offspring, Mendelian-consistent / inconsistent calls, and apparent internal switches within the block. Rolled up by the harvester to one row of thesis Table 7.3 per candidate.
question: Q2
source_script: to be wired against the pedigree from chapter 6

family_id.description: Broodline / family label inherited from the relatedness pipeline.

n_informative_offspring.description: Offspring whose parental karyotype combination makes the segregation test informative.

n_consistent.description: Offspring whose karyotype is consistent with Mendelian segregation from the parents.

n_inconsistent.description: Offspring whose karyotype is not consistent with any Mendelian outcome from the parental classes.

n_internal_switches.description: Apparent recombinant switches within the block in this family's offspring.
